title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Compound Interest
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The amount on a sum of ₹2,800 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
questions.explain:
The formula for Compound Interest amount is $A = P\left(1 + \frac{R}{100}\right)^t$.
$P = 2800$, $R = 10\%$, $t = 2$.
$A = 2800\left(1 + \frac{10}{100}\right)^2 = 2800(1.1)^2 = 2800 \times 1.21 = 3388$.
The amount will be ₹3,388.
